behavior: While `KeepAlive` holds the popup of an open Popover, or the viewport of an open Navigation Menu, the Tab key skips the popup, as it skips a popup with no tabbable element. This is also true when the popup mounts in a held branch. Tab moves the focus from the trigger to the next tabbable element, and Shift+Tab moves it from that element to the trigger. Each press thus moves the visible focus one time. Tab from `Popover.Trigger` asks for the close with the reason `focus-out`. Tab from `NavigationMenu.Trigger` closes the item with the same reason in the cases where Tab from the end of the viewport closes it. The outside guards at the place of a portal do the same when `KeepAlive` holds the popup and not the portal part. Base UI has no counterpart of `KeepAlive`.
